text:
incident-bot: PAGER: prod-us-east-1 GPU pool exhausted. queue_depth=2103, throttle_rate=95%. Autoscaler failing to add gpu-nodes. Sev=1 — paging on-call and infra.
kevin: On it, pulling autoscaler & ASG state.
kevin: kubectl -n kube-system logs deploy/cluster-autoscaler --tail=200
```
E 02:11:58 autoscaler.go: failed to scale up: ASG gpu-pool desired=20 max=20
W 02:12:03 provider_aws.go: error getting instance profile for LaunchTemplate: AccessDenied: User is not authorized to perform iam:PassRole on resource arn:aws:iam::xxxx:role/eks-node-role
```
maria: Confirming ASG gpu-pool at max=20. Autoscaler keeps trying but can't create instances due to LaunchTemplate -> InstanceProfile passrole access error and also some LT version mismatch.
dan: If instances launch but bootstrap fails, nodes won't register and CA keeps retrying, hitting ASG limits — we get stuck in a loop.
maria: I see several LaunchTemplate versions: v2 -> old-bootstrap, v3 -> new-ami+drivers. Autoscaler is selecting LT v2 in us-east-1a because of zone balancing rules. v2's user-data fails newer kernel driver install.
kevin: Checking cloud-init from a recent failed instance:
```
Cloud-init: Running /var/lib/cloud/scripts/boot-strap.sh
boot-strap.sh: line 72: ./install-nvidia.sh: No such file or directory
ERROR: GPU driver install failed: incompatible kernel ABI
kubelet: failed to register node: certificate signed by unknown authority
```
dan: Two immediate mitigations: 1) bump ASG max and desired to get more capacity while we debug; 2) launch a small set of nodes using LT v3 AMI manually so they register.
maria: I'll do (1) now. Increasing max to 30, desired to 28 (short-term).
maria: aws autoscaling update-auto-scaling-group --auto-scaling-group-name gpu-pool --max-size 30 --desired-capacity 28
ops-bot: AWS: update accepted. current_desired=28 current_max=30 (request id: req-0a1b2c)
kevin: New instances starting but seeing same cloud-init failures on ones using LT v2. Manually launched instances with LT v3 show kernels/drivers okay and kubelet registers.
kevin: Manually launched 4 nodes (ami:ami-0abcd1234 v3) -> they joined as node-role=gpu, taint gpu=true:NoSchedule present as expected then removed by bootstrap.
sophie: Customer impact: batch-inference job queue delayed. Early estimate: 12% of high-throughput customers affected, median delay ~12m, some outliers >30m. Sending a brief status to SRE-customers.
sophie: Draft msg -> "We're investigating GPU capacity issues in us-east-1 causing delays to batch inference. We've applied emergency capacity and are restoring service; we'll follow up with root cause and ETA."
dan: Root cause hypothesis: LT v2 fallback (old user-data) + IAM PassRole missing for autoscaler service account -> autoscaler couldn't spin correct LT version or instance profile; causes repeated failed launches and ASG hit max.
maria: Follow-ups: open ticket to lock autoscaler to prefer LT v3, add LT version health check, and add iam:PassRole to autoscaler service account (or confirm cluster role mapping).
maria: Creating ticket INF-4897 with steps and rollback plan.
nate: I'll take the handoff in 30m. Summary for night oncall: manual ASG bump done, 4 manual v3 nodes registered, still investigating LT->iam mapping. Next actions: revert ASG max when stable, ensure autoscaler has PassRole, and run bootstrap smoke tests across zones.
kevin: Quick reproduction step: scale nodegroup to 1 with LT v2, check /var/log/cloud-init-output.log for boot-strap.sh errors.
maria: :thumbsup: I'll coordinate a canary to set autoscaler to prefer LT v3 in us-east-1a then revert.
ops-bot: Incident timeline updated. Incident severity remains 1 until queues < 100 and throttle_rate < 5%.
incident-bot: Handoff: paging @nate in 30m, channel will remain open for updates.
